The service is published by an independent developer reachable at admin@caresse.app.
By using the app, you declare under your own responsibility that you have reached the legal age of majority in your country of residence.

3. Nature of AI-Generated Content
Experiences produced by Caresse are generated in real time by Artificial Intelligence. This content has the following characteristics:

• Non-deterministic: two generations using the same parameters may produce different results.
  • Fictional: experiences are works of sensory narrative fiction. They do not constitute actual instructions, or medical, psychological, or behavioral recommendations of any kind.
  • Imperfect: the AI may produce narrative inconsistencies, repetitions, or unexpected phrasing. The publisher does not guarantee uniform quality across every generation.
  • Pseudonymized: generation parameters (including the first name or alias provided) are transmitted to third-party AI services without any data that directly identifies the user (no full legal name, email address, or account identifier).
The publisher is not the author of the generated content within the meaning of copyright law. The AI acts as an automated narrative suggestion tool.

Detailed terms of sale, payment, and refunds are set out in the Terms of Sale.
